name: Global Oriental Berhad
overview: 今年公司出售了位于 Pavilion Embassy 的18个零售单位，总现金代价 RM35.0 million，涉及零售业务相关资产；其余业务板块在公告中未见扩张、新增或缩减的动态。
overview_en: During the year, the company disposed of 18 stratified retail units at Pavilion Embassy for a total cash consideration of RM35.0 million, involving retail business-related assets; no expansion, new business, or reduction activities were announced for the other business segments.

segments.name: 零售业务
segments.note: 今年公告涉及出售 Pavilion Embassy 的零售单位，属于零售相关资产的处置。
segments.note_en: This year's announcement involves the disposal of retail units at Pavilion Embassy, a disposal of retail-related assets.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Exceed Concept Sdn Bhd 和 Pedoman Ikhtisas Sdn Bhd 与买方签订18份买卖协议，出售 Pavilion Embassy 的18个分层零售单位，总现金代价 RM35.0 million。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiaries Exceed Concept Sdn Bhd and Pedoman Ikhtisas Sdn Bhd entered into 18 sale and purchase agreements with buyers to dispose of 18 stratified retail units at Pavilion Embassy for a total cash consideration of RM35.0 million.
